text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
In 1st place is Rice Shower!!" your 
opponent!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa, haah... Aaah. I've still got a 
long way to go.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...! So many smiling faces...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice did it, Rice really did it... Rice 
was able to do it too...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Rice-san.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Congratulations. It was a wonderful race.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Miss Bourbon...! *sniff*!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Mmmh, that still wasn't enough. Time to 
really get started.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Above all, Rice-san, you were amazing. 
Running alongside you sent shivers down my 
spine!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
The road ahead might still be long, but 
I'll do my best so that I can win someday!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text: I see! Thank you for the positive comment!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text:
"By the way, have you decided on your next 
target race?"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
You're right. I'd love it if I could run 
on a grand stage like this next time too.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
It might be a bit of a stretch, but I'm 
hoping to run in the Takarazuka Kinen!
(Whoa...!)

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my best so that I can win next 
time!

And so, her next race was decided to be 
the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Phew... The track is so quiet in the 
morning."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, the Takarazuka Kinen is 2200m on turf 
clockwise, right? Which means—
Haaaah――!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant*...! Not yet...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I need to grow a lot too, just like 
Rice-san and Tannhauser-san...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
All my regrets from the Tenno Sho (Spring) 
will be poured right into the Takarazuka 
Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Incredible... McQueen is shining so 
bright...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Mun. All right, I've gotta do my best 
too...!

Days of relentless training began, all 
aimed at the middle-distance GⅠ Takarazuka 
Kinen two months away!
